description: What agents searched for on Qumge and found nothing: the demand side of the store, in the searchers' own words, with how often each was searched in the last 7 and 30 days. Useful before building or publishing a capability — it tells you what people already want. Only the search text is stored; no user and no IP.

limit.description: How many to return. Default 20, max 50.

name: list_wanted
